name: gearbox-studio-app
//theiaPlugins: Git. Theia 1.75 does not ship `@theia/git` -- its last release was 1.61.0-next.8 -- so git is the VS Code extension, running in the plugin host. `git-base` is not optional: `vscode.git` depends on it. Versions are pinned in the URL, so an upgrade is an edit somebody makes on purpose rather than a drift. Fetched by `npm run plugins`, deliberately not by `build`: it downloads a third-party artefact over the network, and the precedent in this repo is `npx playwright install chromium` -- an explicit step, documented, never a postinstall.

config.//defaultTheme: Both keys name the same theme on purpose. `defaultTheme` governs the first paint, before preferences are ready (`ThemeServiceWithDB.loadUserTheme` reads `localStorage.theme ?? defaultTheme`); the `workbench.colorTheme` preference below is registered second, shadows the value derived from this one, and is what `validateActiveTheme` settles on. Moving only this key changes nothing observable; moving only the preference leaves a dark first frame that flips. The dark `gearbox-fabric` stays registered and selectable in the Color Theme picker.

preferences.window.title: ${appName}${separator}${dirty}${activeEditorShort}
preferences.//ai-features: Theia AI ships off unless something says otherwise. `@theia/ai-ide` is deliberately NOT installed -- it drags puppeteer-core and an AI terminal surface, which ADR-0011 withdrew -- and it is that package that would rebind AIActivationService to be preference-gated. Without it the service defaults to active, so this key is a statement rather than a switch: the shell offers the chat on purpose. The API key is never written here: Studio's own `gearbox.ai.apiKey` setting is the primary source and wins, and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the backend's environment is the fallback -- see ADR-0011's 2026-09-14 amendment and the root README.
preferences.//tool-confirmation: The eight read tools are pre-approved; `gearbox_toggle_gear` is deliberately absent and so falls back to `defaultToolConfirmation`, which ships as `confirm`. The asymmetry is the ADR-0017 boundary made operational: a read returns engine output and writes nothing, so a per-call dialog in front of it is friction that teaches people to click through dialogs -- which is the habit the write gate depends on them NOT having. The write verb keeps both gates: this one, and the diff dialog `ProductEditService.toggle` shows.
preferences.//files.watcherExclude: Not optional once a workspace is opened. The roots are two Rust checkouts, and `target/` in either is multi-gigabyte -- Theia would walk both. `.gearbox/` is generated output, regenerated wholesale, so watching it reports churn nobody acts on.
